name: Standard Motor Products
outlook:
What Standard Motor Products says to expect

  • Full year 2026: sales growthOur outlook for the full year of 2026 reaffirms our expectation that sales growth will be in the low to mid-single digit range driven by ongoing tailwinds for professional grade non-discretionary products in the North American aftermarket, continuing momentum in our European business, and steady performance in Engineered Solutions, offset by a lapping of both tariff pricing and the benefits of stronger currency conversion.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDA marginReaffirming full-year guidance of low to mid-single digit sales growth and adjusted EBITDA margin of 11% - 12%
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 30, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
